changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS moonpark_pricing_data.tariff_definition ( tariff_id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 ), zone_code character varying(10) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, rule_type character varying(40) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, parameters jsonb NOT NULL, valid_from timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, valid_to timestamp with time zone, active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', created_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), modified_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", modified_date timestamp with time zone, CONSTRAINT tariff_definition_pkey PRIMARY KEY (tariff_id), CONSTRAINT tariff_definition_zone_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (zone_code) REFERENCES moonpark_master_data.parking_zone (zone_code) MATCH SIMPLE ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION, CONSTRAINT tariff_definition_rule_type_check CHECK (rule_type IN ('PER_STARTED_MINUTE', 'HOURLY_WEEKDAY_WEEKEND', 'DAYTIME_FREE_HOUR')), CONSTRAINT tariff_definition_valid_range_check CHECK (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > valid_from), CONSTRAINT tariff_definition_parameters_check CHECK (jsonb_typeof(parameters) = 'object'), -- Safety net: two active versions of the same zone can never overlap in time CONSTRAINT tariff_definition_no_overlap_excl EXCLUDE USING gist (zone_code WITH =, tstzrange(valid_from, valid_to, '[)') WITH &&) WHERE (active) );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS tariff_definition_zone_valid_from_idx ON moonpark_pricing_data.tariff_definition (zone_code, valid_from DESC) WHERE active;

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS moonpark_pricing_data.app_user ( user_id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 ), username character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, email character varying(255) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, full_name character varying(200) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", password_hash character varying(200) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', created_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), modified_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", modified_date timestamp with time zone, CONSTRAINT app_user_pkey PRIMARY KEY (user_id), CONSTRAINT app_user_username_key UNIQUE (username), CONSTRAINT app_user_email_key UNIQUE (email) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS moonpark_pricing_data.user_role ( user_id bigint NOT NULL, role_id bigint NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT user_role_pkey PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id), CONSTRAINT user_role_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES moonpark_pricing_data.app_user (user_id) MATCH SIMPLE ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT user_role_role_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES moonpark_master_data.role (role_id) MATCH SIMPLE ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION );

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS moonpark_pricing_data.api_client ( api_client_id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 ), client_name character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, contact_email character varying(255) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", key_prefix character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, key_hash character varying(64) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, plan_code character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL, enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, expires_at timestamp with time zone, key_rotated_at timestamp with time zone, version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', created_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), modified_by character varying(150) COLLATE pg_catalog."default", modified_date timestamp with time zone, CONSTRAINT api_client_pkey PRIMARY KEY (api_client_id), CONSTRAINT api_client_name_key UNIQUE (client_name), CONSTRAINT api_client_key_hash_key UNIQUE (key_hash), CONSTRAINT api_client_plan_code_check CHECK (plan_code IN ('FREE', 'STANDARD', 'PARTNER')) );
